references.text: The Lord speaks directly to Aaron about the priests' responsibilities, a rare direct speech from God to Aaron without Moses as an intermediary
Aaron is appointed as Moses' spokesman, and here we see God speaking directly to Aaron in his role as high priest
The Lord gives instructions to Aaron through Moses regarding the Aaronic blessing
After the death of Aaron's sons, the Lord gives specific instructions through Moses to Aaron about approaching the sanctuary
The formula 'And the Lord spoke to' is used to introduce divine revelations and instructions
